findings.description: Argument.get_help_record now returns (metavar, self.help) unconditionally. The return annotation is tuple[str, str], but self.help is None when no help was set. The old code substituted an empty string for those arguments.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command where at least one Argument has help and another has no help. The None description is passed to formatter.write_dl at line 1323. HelpFormatter.write_dl wraps the description text, which likely fails on None (for example in wrap_text or a truthiness/len path), so --help can crash with a TypeError or print wrong output. The removed fallback `or (arg.make_metavar(ctx), "")` handled this case.
